theorems.name: Submission.ecf_cp_gram_cone
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (w : Fin k → Euclid P), (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a (t • w) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a (t • w) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j))) = t ^ k * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j)))) ∧ Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j))) ≤ ‖a‖ * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin k => inner ℝ (w i) (w j)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
